The issuer shows weak near-term liquidity with a current ratio of 0.79 (<1), and relatively high leverage given total liabilities of 57,973M versus total assets of 79,154M. However, operating performance is relatively strong with EBIT of 749M on revenue of 3,915M (about a 19% margin), which offsets some of the balance-sheet pressure and supports a mid-to-lower speculative grade.  
DECISION: BB-
